answer: Admission PoW at the orchard gate: each new identity must solve a puzzle calibrated to 120 CPU-hours. The inlet feeds fresh wallets, but the bridge costs scale linearly — 1,000 sybils burn 120,000 CPU-hours (~$9,600 in cloud compute), while honest users pay once. Farming ROI goes negative before ten identities. Verifiable cost asymmetry blocks mass registration.
